info.title: Zabira Academy Public API
info.description:
Public and student APIs for the Zabira Academy website and mobile apps.

**Authentication:** send `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` on protected operations. Tokens are issued by `POST /auth/login.php` (portal `student`) or `POST /auth/google_auth.php`.

Admin, SuperAdmin, teacher-studio, OMS admin, webhooks, cron, and internal debug endpoints are **not** part of this specification.

Standard envelope:

```json
{ "success": true, "message": "…", "data": {} }
```
